on.description: Network-facing ways this workflow can be triggered. Absent means it only runs via direct invocation (e.g. `ens workflow <name>`).

variables.description: Default variables for every job/step in this workflow. A value containing $(NAME) is resolved from the process's own env var NAME at parse time. Overridable by CLI/HTTP-trigger variables.

resources.description: Declarative resources this workflow needs, prepared automatically before jobs run.

jobs.description: Jobs in this workflow, keyed by job id.

repositories.description: Repositories to check out automatically before jobs run, keyed by name. Exposed to every job/step as repositories.<name>.path.

url.description: Git URL to clone. A value containing $(NAME) is resolved from the process's own env var NAME at parse time.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit to check out. Defaults to the remote's default branch.

trigger.description: Exactly one of "manual" or "github" must be set.

inputs.description: Named, typed inputs this trigger accepts, read from the trigger request's inputs.<name> and exposed as trigger.<name>.

manualInput.description: Required unless "default" is set. "type" governs which extra properties apply (e.g. git-tags requires "repository").

name.description: Read from the trigger request's inputs.<name> and exposed as trigger.<name>.

display.description: Human-readable label for a UI to show alongside this input. Purely descriptive.

default.description: Makes this input optional, falling back to this value when omitted. Must match "type".

repository.description: Git repo URL a UI can list tags from to offer as a select. Only valid (and required) for type: git-tags.

tags.description: Glob patterns (e.g. "1.*") matched against the pushed tag name.

needs.description: Job ids that must complete before this job starts.

if.description: Expression gating whether this job runs.

axes.description: Mapping of axis name to a non-empty list of values. The job runs once per combination.

fail-fast.description: Cancel not-yet-started sibling instances when one hard-fails. Defaults to true.

max-parallel.description: Cap how many of this job's instances run concurrently. Defaults to unbounded.

step.description: Exactly one of "run" or "script" must be set.

id.description: Unique id for this step within the job, used to reference its output.

name.description: Human-readable label for this step, shown in logs.

script.description: Path to a script file to run.

if.description: Expression gating whether this step runs.

continue-on-error.description: Don't fail the job if this step fails.

in.description: Runs this step inside a declared resource instead of the run's scratch directory.

repository.description: Name of a resources.repositories entry — this step's cwd defaults to that repository's checkout.
